verdict.rationale: Angular's official CLI ships a first-party `ng e2e` command that builds and serves the app via the dev server before running end-to-end tests (angular-docs-12), and community evidence confirms Angular's testing tooling (Protractor/Karma) has long been considered a core, well-integrated feature (angular-comm-9). Missing for 10: explicit current-day naming of the default e2e tool (Cypress/Playwright/WebDriver) in the evidence pack and independent hands-on confirmation of a frictionless out-of-the-box setup.
